Load effector scores from CSV

Source: R/load.R
load_scores.Rd

Parses a scored CSV file, such as those produced by the omnieff pipeline. The file must have protein_id and custom_score columns; see the "Score file format" section of load_proteins() for details.

Usage

load_scores(path)

Arguments

path

Character. Path to scored CSV file.

Value

A tibble with score columns.

Examples

csv <- system.file("testdata", "assembly1_scored.csv", package = "paneffectR")
scores <- load_scores(csv)
scores[, c("protein_id", "custom_score", "score_rank")]
